drafts.walkScript: Lines 14 and 15 say players in the middle "spend the whole game running". Line 16 starts a list: the speaker knows "who's tired". Line 17 adds "who's got a stitch and won't say it". It sits next to being tired and is hidden, so it is a pain from running. Line 18, "the same trick every single time", is a separate item on the list.
